# nca (Native CLI AI)

> nca is an open-source, Rust-native terminal interface for coding agents. It ships as a single binary with a TUI and REPL, live busy activity, sessions under a unified product home, git worktrees, multi-provider configuration (including custom endpoints), and agent orchestration features.

The project is developed in public on GitHub. Documentation on nca-cli.com mirrors the repository docs. Current release: v0.4.

## Services

- [Product site](https://nca-cli.com/): Overview, What's New in v0.4, install paths, and interactive demo
- [Install](https://nca-cli.com/get-started): One-line install, GitHub Releases (macOS, Linux, Windows), and build-from-source steps
- [Documentation](https://nca-cli.com/docs): Guides for commands, configuration, sessions, tools, providers, and advanced topics
- [Source code](https://github.com/madebyaris/native-cli-ai): Repository, issues, and releases
- [Support](https://nca-cli.com/support): Sponsorship and community support

## What We Do Not Do

nca does not provide hosted inference or a proprietary cloud API as part of this project. Model access depends on user-configured providers and API keys. nca is not legal or security advice; follow your organization's policies for AI tooling and secrets.

## Contact

- Repository and issues: https://github.com/madebyaris/native-cli-ai
- Website: https://nca-cli.com/

- [Documentation index](https://nca-cli.com/docs): All published guides

- [Providers](https://nca-cli.com/docs/providers): MiniMax, Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, custom endpoints
- [Advanced / orchestration](https://nca-cli.com/docs/advanced): Sub-agents, MCP, JSON/NDJSON, IPC

## AI Discovery Files

- [Sitemap index](https://nca-cli.com/sitemap-index.xml): Machine-readable list of site URLs
- [Robots](https://nca-cli.com/robots.txt): Crawler policy and sitemap location
- [llm.txt alias](https://nca-cli.com/llm.txt): Same content as this file for compatibility
